intended_object: The predicate saying a generalized continued fraction h + a₀/(b₀ + a₁/(b₁ + …)) is a simple continued fraction, meaning every partial numerator aᵢ equals 1. Taken from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
`partNums` is the sequence of partial numerators of the generalized continued fraction, defined as `g.s.map Pair.a`. The predicate says that every entry that exists (`get? n = some aₙ`) equals 1. That is exactly the standard definition of a simple continued fraction inside the class of generalized continued fractions.

It is stated for any type with `One`, which is the minimal setting the condition needs, so it is not too narrow.

Finite (terminating) continued fractions are handled correctly: positions past the end of the sequence impose no condition. This declaration is itself the Mathlib definition, so there is no separate Mathlib counterpart to cite.
